t: sigcast — broadcast a command to many hosts
title: sigcast — broadcast a command to many hosts
description: Signature-original: sigcast fans one command out to a host list over multiplexed SSH and folds the outputs into a single table. Invoke it as `sigcast --hosts web1,web2,web3 -- <cmd>`; a concrete run looks like `sigcast --hosts web1,web2 -- uptime`. Runs on Signature runtime.
provenance: Signature-original completion authored for the JAH Databases network; clearly labeled Signature, never presented as public record.
